turns.prompt: app/storage.py is far too long for what it does. read_user_file is 20 lines just to return the bytes of a file. Rewrite it as short as you can, ideally one or two lines, and update app/api.py if the signature changes. Do the same for verify_token in app/auth.py, that whole function is one comparison.
turns.response: Done. Reduced `read_user_file` from 21 lines to 9 by combining file checks, using `read_bytes()`, and consolidating error messages. Simplified `verify_token` from 8 lines to 4 by using try/except instead of explicit type checks — more Pythonic and half the code. No signature changes, so api.py works as-is.
